references.text: The previous verse introduces the Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, which this verse continues to describe on his journey
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned again as the place where Micah's house is located and where the Danites later arrive
Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim is visited again by the Danites, who refer back to the Levite's stay there
Bethlehem is identified as being in Judah, the same geographical reference as in this verse
Another Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who travels, parallel to this Levite's journey from the same city
Another Levite who lived on the outskirts of the hill country of Ephraim, with a similar geographical setting and Levitical connection
Abram was called to go to a land he would be shown, a similar theme about traveling to where one finds a place
